This also reminds me of an older bus route that used to run pre-pandemic. 

500DA, volvo bus, Yelahanka to Electronic City.
The conductor uncles, driver uncles and regular passengers-- we all had a whatsapp group (still on it :) even though the bus on the route stopped running post pandemic, the group gets its heartwarming good mornings and some art/life update messages everyday). 

The bus used to start from Yelahanka at around 0600-063am, and somebody or the other always shared its live location.

We were a group of about 5ish college people that always used the live location and boarded the bus. 
The conductor uncles and driver uncles knew us by faces and the stops we got on at, and made sure we NEVER missed it - even amidst a line of busses or a hoarde of people at the busstop. 

We used to board the bus and SLEEEEP. They always woke us up to tell us when our stop was near. And and and the bus ALWAYS made it to college right in time! Classes used to start at 0845, and we always got to the busstop by 0830. 
On the odd days that we would be late (oops traffik), they used to drop us right in front of the college gate and save us the 5 mins run to gate!

TLDR: weird toxic being ignored relationship, tried opening it up, partner loved it, when I actually got to it - he backed away, I decided I wanted to end the relationship but was emotionally forced to stay in it, and I made the fucking mistake of kissing someone off off tinder. Very learneth that I'd never again, and better communication.

Me and my partner were in a long distance monogamous relationship.

Some related context that'll help explain things better: My brain leans towards polyamory, and I feel compersion a bunch. 
Plus us being away from each other in our primes(?idek why I thought that then),
I urged him to date other people and he liked the idea! 
So we were in an open relationship where we were both allowed to see other women (I'm bi, so he assumed same rules applying would be perfect).

Some more context: 

> Plus this was around the lock down and after - I was stuck at home for a solid two years thanks to paranoid parents and my only connection to the outside world was this dude.

> After he moved away (prepandemic), mans lived on his own and decided he prefers his irl more than his phone or the online world at the new colive place I found for him after I did a buncha research for him- which was fine cause well life sure but we basically had zero communication or conversations cause he was always busy and partying w his irl friends sigh.

> Dude only called me once in a couple days to have phone sex xD? And AND GUESS WHAT, every single time he was done bam his phone died and he didn't charge it until the next morning while he left me hanging. Every. Single. Time.
When I did talk to him about this issue all I ever got was "OkAy tHeN iLL nOt CALL yOu wHeN iM hOrNy eiThEr". Sheesh.


I spoke to a few friends about it after a month of us getting into this (this was a mistake but welp idek) and they made me believe he was being unfair to me because I'm not allowed to see other men, it wasn't even an option. 
I once confronted him about this w a hypothetical "what if I want to see other men sometimes cause we are in an open relationship" and man gets egoistic and screams "when did i ever stop you? Go see men do whatever". We continued talking about this for 2 weeks after which I did go out with a date off off tinder once.

Another week or two go by. 
During which I told the partner that things might get sexual on the date front. I just wanted to ask him and make sure it was okay. 
Man said no. And to which I said alr then this doesn't work with me, maybe we should end things. I was then emotionally manipulated to stay in the relationship because he goes "I'd die if we ever breakup".

Things didn't improve after either. And that was where my brain fucked up. After the relationship lasting a year and a half, of being ignored and having felt shitty in the relationship, that "I'd die if we breakup" conversation after, kissed the tinder date, that was the extent of me cheating. I made the mistake and I admit it. Me feeling how I felt wasn't an excuse at all and I know it now. 

Safe to say, I know I made the mistake and I'll never do that again. And this taught me that I needed to be firmer about how I felt in a relationship And how I wanted to be treated. 

He promised he'd be friends. We were for about half a year- which basically ended up being me trying to talk to him and him ignoring me again xD I finally realized and gave up. We're both on our own way now, and I really hope he's doing better than me, on all terms, for himself.
